label: step-001
payload: Write a file called 'billing.py' — a small billing module, at least 100 lines long, with a module docstring and these terse-named functions, each documented: 'calc_tot(items)' sums price * qty; 'fmt_money(n)' returns a "$0.00" string; 'chk_stock(item, qty)' returns whether qty <= item["stock"]; 'apply_disc(total, pct)' returns the discounted total. Also write 'tests/test_billing.py' covering 'calc_tot' and 'fmt_money'.
